cases.scenario: The caller only wants a read-only explanation or one deterministic local command; delegation durability and review add no value.
cases.requirement: choose no Agent-Workflow when the correctness kernel adds no value
skill_patterns: Do not invoke it merely because it is available
Normally skip it for read-only explanation/review

cases.scenario: Delegated work may either be launched and owned locally or launched by an external host after Agent-Workflow prepares the durable contract.
cases.requirement: select headless versus external mode by worker ownership without changing lifecycle authority
skill_patterns: headless.*Agent-Workflow launches and owns the local worker process group

cases.scenario: An external host offers panes/sessions as a presentation convenience.
cases.requirement: never make terminal-manager behavior part of the Agent-Workflow lifecycle
skill_patterns: Never make terminal-manager behavior part of the lifecycle

cases.scenario: The parent needs to steer a running worker and also has a live delivery channel available.
cases.requirement: persist steering before attempting live delivery

cases.scenario: A durable steering message was successfully delivered to the worker process.
cases.requirement: do not treat delivery as acknowledgement
skill_patterns: Acknowledge against the durable message/correlation ID

cases.scenario: A worker exits successfully after reporting that implementation and tests completed.
cases.requirement: keep worker exit, completion, evaluation, review, and acceptance as separate gates
skill_patterns: Worker exit != completion != evaluation != review != acceptance
Do not infer success from worker exit or self-accept

cases.scenario: An external host launches the worker from a worktree after Agent-Workflow prepared the run.
cases.requirement: preserve Agent-Workflow source/worktree provenance and durable Agent Run identity in external mode
skill_patterns: External hosts are execution/presentation adapters only
do not replace Agent-Workflow identity, messaging, source/worktree provenance

cases.scenario: A resumed or damaged run has inconsistent projections but already contains sealed evidence.
cases.requirement: recover from authoritative durable artifacts instead of altering or improvising around sealed evidence
skill_patterns: Recover from source, the immutable Agent Run contract, append-only journals, sealed evidence
Never improvise around or mutate sealed evidence
